name: beeper-synch
description: Mac-only supervisor for the existing Beeper sync pipeline: spawns packages/beeper-ws (long-lived, backoff-restarted) and schedules packages/beeper-sync (periodic incremental REST sync, serialized) as one process with a single-instance lock and graceful shutdown. No Beeper/Mongo sync logic of its own — see README.md.

scripts.test: tsx src/config.test.ts && tsx src/lock.test.ts && tsx src/backoff.test.ts
